notes.title: WE NOW HAVE TRADING CARDS!
notes.notes: The Glorious Leader COMMANDS you to replay Great eSports Manager again and again to unlock all of the new trading cards, backgrounds, badges, and emoticons.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.1 (#4)
notes.notes:
CHANGES IN VERSION 1.1.1

Additions:
- Sorting players based on skill in player choose ui for contests.
Fixes:
- Bug when placing player outside of a tile fixed, would allow user to hold player without holding mouse button down.
- Attempt #2: Ego number text would not reset on Player UI when selecting a player with neutral ego, should now be fixed.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.0 (#3)
notes.notes:
CHANGES IN VERSION 1.1.0

Additions:
- Indicator to show which player is currently selected.
- A highlight for the currently selected player's portrait.
- Added a text to make it more clear that you can fire people using the trashcan.
- Tab indicator to try to explain the feature of tabbing through portraits/players.
Changes:
- Challenge/Scrim times have been altered and should now appear less frequently in the later stages of the game.
- Altered difficulty of automatic contests.
- Trashcan removed from world map view.
Fixes:
- Ego number text would not reset on Player UI when selecting a player with neutral ego, should now be fixed.
- Cut off sound from hospital/trial/bribe bill as player pays.
- Music would in some cases still play even if music had been turned off, should now be fixed.
- Swat/Quit event triggering twice for the same player fixed.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.2 (#2)
notes.notes:
CHANGES IN VERSION 1.0.2

Changes:
- (Twitch)Swat and quit events are now 15 seconds and votes made by viewers have tripled effect compared to before.
- Changed Save&Quit button in options to just quit.
- Final fight has been made easier as the general consensus seem to be that it was too hard.
Fixes:
- Clicking anywhere on Contest Entry UI that did not have a button would close the UI, this should now be fixed.
- A save bug related to number of players allowed for contests has been fixed.
- Roofs and stilts would sometimes overlap with newly built room.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.1 (#1)
notes.notes:
We want to thank everyone for giving us such great feedback.  We have fixed the following bugs, and done some quality of life updates that you guys requested.  More patches are coming soon!

CHANGES IN VERSION 1.0.1

Additions:
- Close UI with ESC/Right click
- Tooltip description when hovering over an unlocked item
- Tab key now cycles through the players, opening the Player UI and showing the stats for each.
- Tooltip for income level.
- Pause/play button on HUD.
Changes:
- Slightly increased hitbox for house expand buttons, hopefully easier to notice now.
- New icon for item shop.
- Close Contest Entry UI and Contest Locked UI on mouse click outside the UI.
Fixes:
- No longer allow choosing a higher resolution than your system supports, potential fix for issues with GNOME.
- Indicator arrows would sometimes disappear during tutorial, should no longer happen.
- Missing Russian texts added.
- Fixed bug relating to skill gain and using indoor objects outside
